text:
Student P uses a force of 35N to push a box 3.0m across the floor.
Student Q uses a force of 22N to push another box 1.8m across the floor.
Which statement gives a full explanation why student P uses more energy than student Q?
A
Student P pushes his box a greater distance than student Q.
B
Student P pushes his box a greater distance and uses a bigger force than student Q.
C
Student P uses a bigger force than student Q.
D
Student P pushes a heavier box than student Q.

options.label: A
options.text: Student P pushes his box a greater distance than student Q.

options.label: B
options.text: Student P pushes his box a greater distance and uses a bigger force than student Q.

options.label: C
options.text: Student P uses a bigger force than student Q.
